title: A Bakery for the Harbor
author: Ulyana Halloran
blurb: Mara Voss, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
